caseName: Ohio Public Employees Deferred Compensation Progam v. Sicherman
caseNameFull: The OHIO PUBLIC EMPLOYEES DEFERRED COMPENSATION PROGRAM v. Marvin A. SICHERMAN, Trustee

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit. The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment is vacated and the case is remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit for further consideration in light of Patterson v. Shumate, 504 U.S. -, 112 S.Ct. 2242, — L.Ed.2d - (1992).
